notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for official IEEE 1516.1 ownership-acquisition publication and pending-state boundaries. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies ObjectClassNotPublished before class publication, AttributeNotPublished when only a different attribute is published at the known class, unchanged ownership after both rejections, and a later exact-attribute tagged transfer through Divestiture If Wanted. It also checks invalid attributes, release denial, overlapping If Available and regular requests, exact direct-acquisition subsets, and the no-pending Release Denied boundary. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador publication, subscription, known-object-class lookup, ownership acquisition, Divestiture If Wanted, ownership status, unpublication, release denial, object deletion, and resignation services with FederateAmbassador discovery and ownership callbacks
